wrap_module_with_simplefsdp: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with SimpleFSDP to enable fully sharded data parallel training across GPUs
use_local_state_dicts_context: use the local_state_dicts context manager to get per-rank local state dicts instead of consolidated ones
customize_allgatherparametrization: customize the AllGatherParametrization forward and right_inverse methods to control how parameter shards are gathered and split
configure_compile_time_fusion_passes: configure the post_grad_custom_post_pass to fuse all_gather and reduce_scatter operations at torch compile time
register_custom_ops_with_xformers: register custom batched all_gather and reduce_scatter ops via xformers get_python_lib for CUDA and Meta backends
